- “Goal for this session: migrate the invoice PDF export in ledgerly/exports/pdf.py to the async job queue.”

- Per-invoice embedding requests: too slow.
- Unbounded/imbalanced requests: mocks showed a single 100-document batch.
- Tenant-less invoice scanning: superseded by `Invoice.for_tenant(self.tenant_id)`.
- Retrying webhook handlers with 5 attempts: resent customer emails multiple times.

- [pending] Rebase/squash if triggered: status unknown.

- Mypy after fixing the generator return type: status unknown.

Finished UTF-8 CSV regression work and began billing type cleanup.
